 Trouw Nutrition highlights strategies for Feeding the Future Sustainably at EuroTier 2026
 

 Information and demonstrations showcase new ways to boost production efficiency and reduce carbon footprint 

 

 
 
 
 
 22 October 2026
 
 

 
 
 
 2 minute read
 
 

 
 
 
 By: Laurence Williams 
 

 

 
 
 

 

 

 

 Trouw Nutrition, Nutreco’s livestock feed business line, will feature the company’s newest precision nutrition tools, technologies, and programmes at EuroTier 2026, 10-13 November, in Hanover, Germany. Visitors to Trouw Nutrition Stand A16 in Hall 22 can learn about science-based nutrition, explore a variety of hands-on digital technologies including a virtual reality experience, attend in-stand sessions with experts, and discover programmes designed to support sustainability across the animal protein value chain. Throughout the event, Trouw Nutrition will highlight sustainability-focused tools and early life nutrition supports to help lower emissions, improve animal performance, and contribute to farm profitability.

Nutrition innovations recognised by DLG Innovation Commission

Visitors can check out two innovations recognised by the independent DLG Innovation Commission--Milkiwean ActiBar and BroilerSim. “We are proud to be recognised for these innovative technologies,” said Trouw Nutrition CEO Eduardo Alberto. “Trouw Nutrition has long been an innovation leader in animal nutrition. Our goal is to deliver integrated solutions to improve performance, strengthen resilience, enhance efficiency, and help create a more sustainable future for the animal feed industry.” 

Hands-on digital demos

An in-stand demonstration area will invite visitors to interact with technologies that support sustainable livestock production. 

Trouw Nutrition’s Mycotoxin Monitor helps customers strengthen mycotoxin risk management by identifying the mycotoxins most prevalent in their region and highlighting emerging risks to watch for. 

The NutriOpt On-site Adviser provides precise, on-the-spot feed analysis to help users create precision feeding strategies to improve performance and reduce costs.

The renewed MyFeedPrint and MyMilkPrint and MyEggPrint, MyChickenPrint and MyPorkPrint are part of Trouw Nutrition’s Carbon Reduction Programmes. They calculate the carbon footprint of feed or products like milk and eggs, allowing producers to make better decisions on formulation, raw material selection, and feeding strategies while achieving greater transparency throughout the value chain.  

The BroilerSim and LayerSim models let users create digital twins: “what if” feeding scenarios and evaluate potential outcomes to see how changes in formulation might affect animal development, including growth rate, feed conversion, carcass, and breast yield in broilers as well as egg production in layers, across different breeds. Being able to predict likely responses helps improve operational efficiency and decision-making.

Trouw Nutrition’s VR Experience for its PhytoComplex Solutions is a cutting-edge, interactive virtual reality tour that showcases the benefits and applications of phytotechnology in animal nutrition, showing how these solutions can enhance animal resilience and performance.

Expert presentations

Trouw Nutrition will launch its Sow Excellence Programme on 11 November at its stand. The programme connects science, nutrition, digital intelligence, management, expertise, and performance across every lifecycle stage. The global launch of Trouw Nutrition’s Carbon Reduction Programme will be held on 12 November and presented by Trouw Nutrition ECA Director Pieter Bastiaanssen and Marketing Director Bettina Stier.

Trouw Nutrition experts will share insights on science-based strategies to support more sustainable feed production, precision farming, and livestock production.  Seminar topics include Navigate. Sustain. Succeed. Transforming the dairy value chain through lifetime nutrition, digital decision support and predictive with Liz Homer; Every Sow Starts with Potential with Francis Simard; and From Biosecurity to Immunity: Building Resilient and High-Performing Poultry Flocks with Morvarid Rezvani. 

Comprehensive information on speakers, topics, and other presentation details is available at Trouw Nutrition at EuroTier 2026 | Hanover, Germany - Trouw Nutrition.

translationZh:
Trouw Nutrition，Nutreco的畜禽饲料业务线，将在2026年11月10-13日于德国汉诺威举行的EuroTier 2026上展示公司最新的精准营养工具、技术和项目。参观Trouw Nutrition位于22号馆A16展位的观众可以了解基于科学的营养方案，探索包括虚拟现实体验在内的多种动手数字技术，参加展位内专家讲座，并发现旨在支持动物蛋白价值链可持续发展的项目。整个活动期间，Trouw Nutrition将重点展示以可持续发展为核心的工具和早期生命营养支持方案，以帮助降低排放、改善动物性能并促进农场盈利能力。

**获DLG创新委员会认可的 nutrition 创新**

参观者可以了解两项获得独立DLG创新委员会认可的创新——Milkiwean ActiBar和BroilerSim。“我们为这些创新技术获得认可感到自豪，”Trouw Nutrition首席执行官Eduardo Alberto表示。“Trouw Nutrition长期以来一直是动物营养领域的创新领导者。我们的目标是提供整合解决方案，以提高性能、增强韧性、提升效率，并帮助为动物饲料行业创造更可持续的未来。”

**动手数字演示**

展位内的演示区将邀请参观者与支持可持续畜牧生产的技术进行互动。

Trouw Nutrition的霉菌毒素监测器帮助客户加强霉菌毒素风险管理，识别其所在地区最流行的霉菌毒素，并突出显示需要关注的新兴风险。

NutriOpt现场顾问提供精确的即时饲料分析，帮助用户制定精准饲喂策略，以提高性能并降低成本。

更新后的MyFeedPrint以及MyMilkPrint、MyEggPrint、MyChickenPrint和MyPorkPrint是Trouw Nutrition碳减排项目的一部分。它们计算饲料或牛奶、鸡蛋等产品的碳足迹，使生产者能够在配方、原料选择和饲喂策略方面做出更好的决策，同时实现整个价值链更高的透明度。

BroilerSim和LayerSim模型让用户创建数字孪生：“假设”饲喂场景并评估潜在结果，以了解配方变化可能如何影响动物发育，包括不同品种肉鸡的生长速度、饲料转化率、胴体和胸肉产量，以及蛋鸡的产蛋量。能够预测可能的反应有助于提高运营效率和决策水平。

Trouw Nutrition为其PhytoComplex解决方案提供的VR体验是一项前沿的互动虚拟现实之旅，展示植物技术在动物营养中的益处和应用，展示这些解决方案如何增强动物韧性和性能。

**专家演讲**

Trouw Nutrition将于11月11日在其展位启动母猪卓越计划。该计划连接科学、营养、数字智能、管理、专业知识和性能，贯穿每个生命周期阶段。Trouw Nutrition全球碳减排项目发布会将于11月12日举行，由Trouw Nutrition ECA总监Pieter Bastiaanssen和营销总监Bettina Stier介绍。

Trouw Nutrition专家将分享关于支持更可持续饲料生产、精准农业和畜牧生产的科学策略的见解。研讨会主题包括Liz Homer主讲的“导航。维持。成功。通过终身营养、数字决策支持和预测转型乳品价值链”；Francis Simard主讲的“每头母猪都始于潜力”；以及Morvarid Rezvani主讲的“从生物安全到免疫：构建有韧性且高产的禽群”。

关于演讲者、主题和其他演讲详情的全面信息，请访问Trouw Nutrition at EuroTier 2026 | Hanover, Germany - Trouw Nutrition。
